name: Report to Hadrec
summary: Apothecary Renferrel sends you to Hadrec as the Scourge threat grows. After Renferrel and Bethor Iceshard investigate the Scourge presence in Lake Lordamere, High Executor Hadrec directs Silverpine's military preparations against Fenris Isle.

sections.title: Escalation in Silverpine
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel and Bethor Iceshard have studied the danger posed by the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw. But study alone cannot break the Scourge stronghold rising on Fenris Isle. Ravenclaw is binding the restless dead there, and Renferrel sees that alchemy and magic will not be enough. The Forsaken military must bring its steel and discipline to bear, so Renferrel sends you to the commander.

sections.title: The High Executor's Arsenal
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec directs Silverpine Forest's strategic operations for the Dark Lady from the Sepulcher's crypts. Bethor's warnings about Ravenclaw reach him, and Hadrec knows a necromancer entrenched on Lordamere's western shore threatens Undercity's flank. He opens the local garrison's armory to equip the vanguard before sending them against the island fortress.

faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec commands the Forsaken forces stationed at the Sepulcher. He oversees defense and offensive operations throughout Silverpine Forest and answers to Undercity's leadership.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel send you to Hadrec?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel sends you to Hadrec because he and Bethor Iceshard found that Thule Ravenclaw has gathered a dangerous Scourge force on Fenris Isle. An entrenched necromancer calls for military strength and proper equipment, so Renferrel turns to the garrison's commander.
The Sepulcher is a fortified Forsaken settlement and tomb complex in central Silverpine Forest. It is the Horde's main hub and staging ground for operations in the region.
Thule Ravenclaw is a powerful Scourge necromancer who seized Fenris Keep on Fenris Isle in Lake Lordamere. He raises the dead to build an active beachhead off Silverpine's eastern shore.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Hadrec?
faq.answer: Hadrec gives you supplies from the Sepulcher's armory and orders an immediate strike on Fenris Isle. The attack aims to eliminate Thule Ravenclaw and break the Scourge hold on Lake Lordamere.

faq.q: Who is Bethor mentioned by Hadrec?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard is a Forsaken mage who lives in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. His magical divinations helped uncover the nature and danger of Thule Ravenclaw's rituals.

angles.text: The Sepulcher coordinates the Horde's western defense in Lordaeron. It guards the approaches to the ruins of the Capital City against Scourge outposts and human survivors.
As Forsaken, you face Thule Ravenclaw as the Lich King's enslaving will pressing close to home. Destroying him is vital to your people's survival.
